messages:
sam_cs: FYI - LighthouseRx plans a production ramp tomorrow morning. They asked for a short-term regional QPS increase and an IP allowlist for their peered egress. @nora_ops can you prioritize?

nora_ops: On it. I need the exact CIDRs, the desired QPS, region, and how long they want it. Also want a short justification for the change request.

sam_cs: They sent: 52.14.22.0/24 and 52.14.23.12/32. Requesting ap-southeast-1 bump from 50 -> 300 QPS for 72 hours while they finish rollout. They also asked whether we can pre-warm the KV cache for their most common prefixes to avoid cold-token latency spikes.

jiang_eng: I'll prepare the routing/rate-limiter update and set an automatic revoke timer at 72h. Please include the expiry in the ticket text. Example staging command I used earlier: 
```bash
redwoodctl customers update --id lighthouse-rx --allowlist 52.14.22.0/24,52.14.23.12 --qps 300 --region ap-southeast-1 --revoke-in 72h
```

nora_ops: Perfect. I'll run that in staging, run smoke tests, then schedule a small prod window. @sam_cs can you paste the sanitized prod payload for the runbook?

sam_cs: Prod payload (sanitized) below. Please double-check fields before executing.
```json
{
  "customer_id": "lighthouse-rx",
  "change": {
    "region": "ap-southeast-1",
    "qps": 300,
    "allowlist": ["52.14.22.0/24", "52.14.23.12/32"],
    "auto_revoke": "72h"
  },
  "requested_by": "sam_cs"
}
```

sam_cs: Also noting the account: pilot usage looks healthy and they're likely to move to Dedicated if pilot metrics hold. Renewal is ~29 days out. @emma_renewals can you do a proactive check-in and mention this production readiness step? Renewal risk is moderate if we stall.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: change-request created (#CS-7892) by nora_ops - pending infra approval

jiang_eng: Staging applied. Traffic sanity checks look ok for the synthetic load. I'll schedule prod deployment at 10:00 UTC in ~12 minutes. Post-change checks: QPS, 5xx ratio, p99 tail latency. Rollback if 5xx > 1% or error rate > baseline + 0.5%.

nora_ops: Executed prod change at 10:03 UTC. Control plane returned revoke timestamp. Truncated CLI output: 
```json
{"customer":"lighthouse-rx","region":"ap-southeast-1","qps":300,"allowlist":["52.14.22.0/24","52.14.23.12/32"],"revoke":"2026-04-02T10:03:00Z"}
```

sam_cs: :thumbsup: Customer reports traffic flowing. Current 5xx about 0.2% and latency within SLOs. I'll run a KV cache warmup script against their top 25 prefixes now.

emma_renewals: I'll reach out to the account today, share the usage dashboard, and propose a KPI-run to Dedicated (pilot -> committed). Please DM me extra metrics or a short screen recording if you have one.

sam_cs: Action items - 1) confirm auto-revoke execution (nora_ops), 2) publish short KB on cache pre-warm + attach to ticket (sam_cs), 3) renewal outreach + KPI proposal (emma_renewals). Closing thread unless anything else comes up. Thanks all!
